QuestInfo.name: Fenelle's Catalyst
QuestInfo.1: #p3000001# needs a catalyst. Defeat #o2400004# monsters at the #m400030500#, and bring back 20 of their #t4033343# items.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000001# has something to tell you in exchange for your help.

0.0: Hello dear, you must be Angelic Buster. I was certain you would visit me sometime soon. Are you here to offer me your help?

yes.0: I am missing a catalyst, specifically the #t4033343#, required to amplify some of the... Oh, dear, am I boring you? I'd heard you were a little bit of a space cadet. I'll write it down in your quest log for you, okay?

no.0: Don't concern yourself with my silly needs.

1.0: You're quite a little busy bee, aren't you? This should do quite well, thank you.

yes.0: I have felt an ancient presence since I met you. Are you under the protection of an ancient Nova perhaps?

item.0: You don't have to overdo it. Just get me 20 pieces of #t4033343# from the #o2400004# monsters at the #m400030500#.
